Title: Magic of the Smith + Ankara Citadel

Messages.Author: Ira
Messages.Body:
If I use Magic of the Smith to get Ankara Citadel, does my vampire spend 2 blood or 3? Thanks!

Ira

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body: Three, barring any other blood reduction.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Correct.
Pay for the Magic of the Smith, and start searching (you might find nothing, but you pay for searching). Then, pay for whatever you found.
